prompt: 2D animated documentary scene, clean cel shading, bold outlines, flat muted earthy colors, consistent style in every frame. The bearded teamster in a brown felt hat and blue shirt walks steadily forward along the dirt road, legs stepping naturally, holding the reins loosely in one hand, his head turning slightly to look ahead up the road. Beside him the two brown mules walk at a slow steady pace, heads nodding with each step, ears flicking, legs moving in a natural walking gait, pulling the wooden wagon heaped with firewood. The wagon wheels turn and roll over the dirt, light dust rising behind the hooves and wheels. The golden grass and oak leaves sway gently in a light breeze. The camera tracks slowly sideways alongside them, keeping the man, the mules and the wagon in frame. Calm mid-morning light, long soft shadows.
